text:
alex: Noticing tail latency + queue growth across eu-west & us-west GPU pools around 03:12 UTC. Scheduler logs show repeated requeues and a spike in KV cache misses. Not seeing obvious node OOMs.

ops-bot: Alert: gpu-pool-queue-length HIGH (eu-west) at 2026-03-18T03:12:18Z :rotating_light:

maya: I pulled a few structured log samples. Our scheduler namespace sampling in eu-west was 1% so correlation is weak. Suggest bump to 10% for 20m to get better trace density.

sam: +1 to bump. Also flag: some older services still emit `user_email_hash` in nested metadata; our ingest currently only redacts `user_email`. That could be PII. We should pseudonymize `user_email_hash` or drop it.

jess: If we raise sampling, ingest bytes will jump. Plan: route brightened sample traffic into telemetry-debug (short retention) and add a billing guard alert.

alex: Quick action plan: 1) scheduler sampling -> 10% for eu-west/us-west for 20m; 2) route to telemetry-debug with 48h retention; 3) add ingest transform to pseudonymize nested user_email_hash -> user_hash (HMAC); 4) temporary Grafana heatmap for queue_length by host + short-term Prometheus metric for requeues by reason.

tanvi: I'll spin up the Grafana heatmap and a panel on the ad-hoc debugging dashboard. Link draft: https://grafana.internal/d/fleet-debug/kvcache-requeues (will share when live).

maya: Terraform snippet I'll apply (plan/approve):

```yaml
resource: scheduler_sampling
namespace: inference-scheduler
regions: [eu-west, us-west]
sample_rate: 0.10
duration_seconds: 1200
route_to: telemetry-debug
```

sam: Ingest transform concept: drop raw email fields, keep trace_id/host/model, and replace `user_email_hash` with `user_hash = hmac_sha256(kms_key, user_email_hash)`. Use KMS key arn:arn:aws:kms:...:redwood-ingest-hmac. Will add a test vector.

jess: I'll create a budget guard: alert if telemetry-debug daily bytes > 1GiB and a paged slack message to #eng-platform-pager. Also adding a Prometheus recording rule: `scheduler_requeues_total:increase_5m = increase(scheduler_requeues_total[5m])`.

ops-bot: Runbook auto-created: https://confluence.internal/redwood/runbooks/gpu-queue-spike (created by ops-bot)

alex: We should also instrument a short-lived gauge `scheduler_kv_miss_rate` exported by the scheduler service (percent over sliding window). If the KV miss rate > 2% and requeues spike, auto-escalate to oncall.

maya: Quick grep showed a recent deploy to scheduler in eu-west 03:00 UTC that touched cache eviction heuristics. Can we roll that back if metrics confirm correlation?

sam: Rolling back is an option but let's capture more evidence first. I'll increase sampling and push ingest transform as a canary in telemetry-debug only. If the heatmap + KV miss gauge show the deploy as root cause, we coordinate rollback.

jess: I added an alert dashboard row: queue_length > 100 for any host -> warn. queue_length > 500 -> page. Also added an annotation window for 03:00-03:15 to correlate with deploys.

tanvi: Grafana panel is up (read-only link): https://grafana.internal/d/fleet-debug/kvcache-requeues?orgId=1&view=heatmap. Heatmap shows a few hosts with sustained 80-300 queue_length during the window.

maya: Applying terraform now (will hold for approval): plan shows only sampling resource change + route binding to telemetry-debug.

alex: Post-ops checklist: - confirm ingest redact transform is in place for telemetry-debug only, - verify billing guard, - watch heatmap & requeue recording rule for 10m, - create quick postmortem if rollback required.

sam: Pushed a small lambda to pseudonymize nested fields for the telemetry-debug stream. Tests: input user_email_hash=abcd -> user_hash= hmac(...)=f1e2... (test vector saved to repo).

jess: Billing guard created and tested. Alert will fire to #eng-platform and page if limit exceeded.

ops-bot: Update: telemetry-debug retention set to 48h for org redwood-debug.

alex: OK folks, monitor for 30m. If queue_length does not fall back, we escalate to infra. Thanks. :thumbsup:
